name: RecordBook
long_description: RecordBook is one stop solution to manage all business DATA, WORKFLOWS & TEAMS for Small and Medium Businesses on their mobile devices & in their local languages.

app_answers.question: Describe what your company does in 50 characters or less.
How long have each of you been working on this? How much of that has been full-time? Please explain.
app_answers.answer: We've been working on this full time since March 2021.

app_answers.question: What is your company going to make? Please describe your product and what it does or will do.
app_answers.answer:
We aim to help business teams build their own custom processes, workflows without writing a single line of code & through a simple spread sheet like interface. 

We have started with a basic mobile first spreadsheet app where users can
1. Create spreadsheets - Where we offer 18 different data types such as Image, Google Map Location, DropDown, Status etc  for easy data entry

2. Collaborate : A mobile phone based collaboration eliminates the need to email ids and passwords. The added control where admins can limit edit control of members.

3. Export : Users can export either entire sheet or just one row data in PDF format. Later we'll add different export formats to cover different use cases.
